prompt: Remove BETA from the returns. Explain why rejection is preferable to reporting ALPHA's contribution alone.
answer: Removing BETA raises ValueError before aggregation. prompt: Supply duplicate labels and explain why a label-bearing object is not automatically a valid keyed dataset.
answer: Duplicate labels on either input raise ValueError. pandas permits Series with repeated labels, so existence of an Index is not uniqueness validation. For this one-contribution-per-asset model enforce flat,unique,trimmed nonempty string identities and identical asset sets. A valid lot/transaction grain would need distinct keys and another explicit aggregation policy.

prompt: Describe the metadata needed to ensure all supplied returns cover the same interval and currency convention.
kind: CONCEPTUAL METADATA DESIGN — NOT EXECUTED INTEGRATION
answer: Retain stable security identifiers and identifier namespace/source version; common interval start/end instants,time zones,endpoint closure and observation/session calendar; price-only versus total-return methodology,corporate-action/adjustment/distribution basis; price currency and reporting currency,units/multipliers and FX basis; opening-weight valuation time/exposure universe and flow/rebalancing assumptions; event/publication/ingestion times,quote age/revision and source/batch evidence. Validate equality or an explicitly authorized transformation across inputs before calculation. Labels and finite numeric cells alone cannot enforce these fields; this API accepts no metadata object and does not authenticate their truth.
